x.description: ndarray The array to be unstacked.
constraints: x and output must satisfy stack(unstack(x, axis=axis), axis=axis) == x

axis.description: int, optional Axis along which the array will be split. Default: ``0``.
constraints: x and output must satisfy stack(unstack(x, axis=axis), axis=axis) == x

output.description: ------- tuple of ndarrays The unstacked arrays.

constraints: x and output must satisfy stack(unstack(x, axis=axis), axis=axis) == x
